note.sl: Snežišča v zgornjem delu pogosto do julija.
note.en: Snowfields in the upper section often persist into July.

water.sl: V Krmi zadnja pitna voda pri koči; višje je ni.
water.en: Last drinking water at the hut in Krma; there is none higher up.

description.sl: Najbolj položen pristop na Triglav. Dolina Krme se dviga postopoma in do Planike ni nobenega izpostavljenega mesta — prav zato je ta smer priljubljena med tistimi, ki gredo na Triglav prvič. Dolžina je vseeno resna: dva tisoč metrov višinske razlike v eno smer. Od Planike naprej velja enako kot za vse druge smeri.
description.en: The gentlest approach to Triglav. The Krma valley rises steadily and there is no exposure anywhere below Planika, which is exactly why this line is popular with first-timers. The length is still serious: two thousand metres of ascent one way. From Planika onwards the same conditions apply as on every other route.

note.sl: Pokljuka je visoko izhodišče, a zgornji del je enak kot pri drugih smereh.
note.en: Pokljuka is a high trailhead, but the upper section is the same as on every other route.

water.sl: Voda v kočah (Vodnikov dom, Planika); vmes je ni.
water.en: Water at the huts (Vodnikov dom, Planika); none in between.

description.sl: Najmanj višinske razlike od vseh smeri, ker se izhodišče na Rudnem polju začne pri 1347 metrih. Pot čez Velo polje do Vodnikovega doma in naprej na Planiko je tehnično lahka in vodi po odprtem kraškem svetu. Zadnji del je enako zahteven kot povsod drugod.
description.en: The least ascent of any route, because the Rudno polje trailhead already sits at 1347 metres. The path across Velo polje to Vodnikov dom and on to Planika is technically easy and crosses open karst country. The final section is exactly as demanding as everywhere else.

water.sl: Zadnja voda pri Aljaževem domu v Vratih.
water.en: Last water at Aljažev dom in Vrata.

description.sl: Klasična pot iz Vrat, pogosto uporabljena tudi za sestop s Kredarice. Prag je strma stopnja z jeklenicami, krajša in manj izpostavljena od Tominškove poti, a je vseeno zavarovana. Zaradi severne lege je pot dlje v senci in dlje pod snegom.
description.en: The classic route out of Vrata, and the usual way down from Kredarica. Prag is a steep cabled step — shorter and less exposed than Tominškova pot, but cabled nonetheless. Its northern aspect keeps it in shade longer and under snow longer.

water.en: Last water in the Kot valley.

description.sl: Najmanj obljudena od treh mojstranških dolin. Pot se dvigne iz doline Kot proti Staničevemu domu in naprej na Kredarico. Podatki za to smer so v tem viru manj zanesljivi kot za ostale — preveri jih pred odhodom.
description.en: The quietest of the three valleys above Mojstrana. The path climbs out of Kot towards Dom Valentina Stanica and on to Kredarica. The figures for this route are less certain in this source than for the others — check them before you go.

note.en: The longest route; a single-day ascent only for the very fast and experienced.

water.en: Water at Koča pri Triglavskih jezerih and at Dolič.

description.sl: Najdaljši in višinsko najzahtevnejši pristop, a tudi eden najlepših. Komarča je strma zavarovana stopnja takoj na začetku; nad njo se pot umiri v Dolino Triglavskih jezer in se čez Hribarice povzpne na Dolič. Praktično vedno se hodi z eno prenočitvijo.
description.en: The longest approach and the biggest ascent, and also one of the finest. Komarča is a steep cabled step right at the start; above it the path eases into the Valley of the Seven Lakes and crosses Hribarice to reach Dolič. In practice this is always done with an overnight stop.

description.sl: Zavarovana pot že od izhodišča naprej: jeklenice se začnejo nizko nad Vrati in izpostavljenost je resnična skoraj vso pot do Kredarice. Za razliko od Prage tu ni dela, kjer bi si od varovanja odpočil. Čelada in samovarovalni komplet od vznožja, ne šele od koče.
description.en: Cabled from close to the trailhead: the first steel begins low above Vrata and the exposure is real for most of the way to Kredarica. Unlike Prag there is no section here where you get a rest from the protection. Helmet and via ferrata set from the valley floor, not from the hut.

water.sl: Zadnja voda v Zadnjici; na poti je ni.

description.sl: Najtežja označena pot na Triglav in edina, ki pripelje naravnost na vršni greben brez vmesne koče. Dolga, izpostavljena in zahtevna po celotni dolžini. Ni primerna za prvi obisk Triglava in ni primerna za sestop.
description.en: The hardest marked route on Triglav and the only one that leads straight onto the summit ridge with no hut on the way. Long, exposed and demanding along its whole length. Not a route for a first visit to Triglav, and not a descent.

description.sl: Najbolj priljubljen vzpon v Sloveniji in dober prvi cilj. Široka pot skozi gozd, brez izpostavljenih mest, z gostiščem in razgledom na Ljubljansko kotlino na vrhu. Ob lepih vikendih je gneča velika, parkirišče pa polno že zgodaj.
description.en: The most popular climb in Slovenia and a good first objective. A wide forest path with no exposure, an inn at the top and a view over the Ljubljana basin. On fine weekends it is crowded and the car park fills early.

description.sl: Kratka pot z veliko višinske razlike: iz Vipave pri 107 metrih na rob planote pri dobrih 1200. Pot je označena in tehnično lahka, a strma in v spodnjem delu poleti zelo vroča. Nadmorska višina vrha je zavajajoča — po naporu je to pravi gorski dan.
description.en: A short path with a lot of ascent: from Vipava at 107 metres to the plateau edge at just over 1200. The route is marked and technically easy, but steep, and the lower half gets very hot in summer. The summit altitude is misleading — in effort this is a full mountain day.

description.sl: Strm vzpon skozi gozd do Doma pod Storžičem in nato po melišču in skalnatem svetu proti vrhu. Zgornji del je izpostavljen in mestoma zahteva roke. Kamenje se rado sproži — pod drugimi pohodniki bodi previden.
description.en: A steep climb through forest to Dom pod Storžičem, then up scree and rock towards the summit. The upper section is exposed and asks for hands in places. Loose rock is easily dislodged — take care below other walkers.

description.sl: Dolg, a tehnično nezahteven vzpon mimo Krnskega jezera na enega najbolj razglednih vrhov v Julijskih Alpah. Zgornji del je odprt in brez sence. Na vrhu in okoli njega so ostanki soške fronte — ne premikaj jih in ne pobiraj najdb.
description.en: A long but technically undemanding climb past Krnsko jezero to one of the finest viewpoints in the Julian Alps. The upper section is open and shadeless. There are First World War remains on and around the summit — leave them where they are and do not collect finds.

description.sl: Kratek in prijazen vzpon na najvišji vrh slovenske Istre. Pot vodi skozi gozd in nato po travnatem pobočju do vrha, s katerega se ob jasnem vremenu vidi od Julijcev do Jadrana. Primerno za družine in za zimo.
description.en: A short, friendly climb to the highest summit in Slovenian Istria. The path goes through woodland and then up grassy slopes to a top that, on a clear day, sees from the Julian Alps to the Adriatic. Suitable for families and for winter.

description.en: A climb from the Mežica valley onto the border ridge of Peca. Far quieter than the Julian Alps, with a view over the Karavanke and into Austria. The path is marked, open in its upper part, and steep in places.

description.en: A pleasant climb up the grassy flanks of the Karavanke above Jesenice. Technically undemanding, though the upper section is open and wind-exposed. During the daffodil bloom it is one of the prettiest and most crowded walks in Slovenia.
